task.description:
Validate the test design for ISS-102.

Verify all hard-gate criteria:
1. Every MUST acceptance criterion from ISS-102 has a runnable integration test
2. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests
3. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs
4. Tests clean up after themselves
5. Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent

Specifically check that both test plan items are covered:
- Concurrent double-claim test (two workers, one wins 200, other gets 409)
- Completion authorization test (only claimed_by or USER-assigned assignee_ref may complete)
acceptance_criteria: PASS: all ISS-102 MUST criteria have integration tests

result.summary: Test design for ISS-102 validated — all 8 MUST acceptance criteria have integration tests (TC-ISS-102-01 through TC-ISS-102-08), fixtures use per-test unique definition names and instances, cleanup deferred in every test, BPM_TEST_DB_URL absence produces a clear error (not SkipZigTest), parameterized SQL throughout. Spec case count (8) matches implementation test block count (8). Concurrent double-claim (TC-02) and completion authorization (TC-05 through TC-08) are both fully covered.
